purpose: Everything a line-of-business application would otherwise build for itself, resolved at compile time. Install the package for what you need and write one Add call.
readThisFirst: Before writing a foundational abstraction — caching, validation, a repository, a result type, a pipeline — check this catalog. If Zero has it, use it. Writing a second one is the mistake this framework exists to prevent.

capabilities.title: Validated configuration
capabilities.useWhen: Any time the application reads a setting.

capabilities.title: Results and errors
capabilities.useWhen: An operation can fail in a way the caller should handle. Do not write your own Result, Either or Maybe type.

capabilities.title: Commands, queries and the pipeline
capabilities.useWhen: The application has use cases. Do not write your own mediator or dispatcher, and do not call a handler directly.
